data.standardized_narrative: In 2015, Syndicate 1110 experienced a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 3.0 million, representing a 2.98% increase relative to opening reserves. This was driven by a GBP 7.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business, partially offset by a GBP 4.7 million surplus on direct business. The overall strengthening indicates adverse claims development on prior year provisions, particularly affecting reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 4.7 million on direct business
deficit on reinsurance accepted business of GBP 7.7 million

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was available. There is a discrepancy between the net run-off deviation of +GBP 3.0m (Claims Outstanding note) and the net prior year result of -GBP 0.5m (Managing Agent's Report); the run-off deviation is used as it directly addresses reserve movement. LOB movements are also net of reinsurance. The claims development table is for net claims incurred, not gross, and therefore could not be used as a source for gross PYD.
